phase: CD-3A — Long-window Path Representation (first sublayer of CD-3)
authority: user GO ruling 2026-10-04: path features BEFORE clustering; all three windows reported; dev/holdout discipline; future outcomes never enter construction
inputs: CD-2B state table (base+mods per l2,date, sha f40d55df) + CD-1B four-axis table (continuous axis values, sha 0f747662) ; OK rows only; INSUFFICIENT_SUPPORT breaks windows (window requires W consecutive OK days ending at T)

path_features_per_sector_T_W_frozen.occupancy: share of days in window by base collapsed to {BROAD_STRENGTH, NARROW_STRENGTH, BROAD_WEAKNESS, NARROW_WEAKNESS, DIVERGENT, NEUTRAL_ANY(=NEUTRAL|NEUTRAL_WIDE_UP|NEUTRAL_WIDE_DOWN)} — 6 shares summing to 1
path_features_per_sector_T_W_frozen.slopes: OLS slope x W (window-total magnitude) computed on daily series: rel_eq_mkt, advance_frac, d_share(=vol_share-vol_share_20d), ret_contrib_top5 (NULL days excluded from fit, require >=W/2 non-null), ret_gap(=top5_mean_ret-rest_mean_ret, same rule)

census_protocol.multimodality_check: for the two primary occupancy features (share_broad_strength, share_divergent) and share_broad_weakness: dev-window histogram (40 bins) — bimodality evidence = interior bin count < 25% of both edge-peak bins for some valley between two local maxima; decision recorded as MULTIMODAL_YES/NO with histogram data
census_protocol.cluster_decision_rule: clustering (KMeans, K in 2..8 by max mean silhouette, standardized with dev-fitted mean/std, cosine of features NOT including endpoints' one-hot) is performed IFF at least one checked feature shows MULTIMODAL_YES; else NO clustering and CD-3B proceeds with continuous features + CD-2C path labels; the decision and its evidence are frozen before CD-3B

dev_holdout.rule: feature DEFINITIONS frozen globally; only standardization params and cluster centroids (if any) are dev-fit

output_contracts.path_table: data/cd/sector_axes/l2_path_features.json.gz — per (l2, date, window) feature vector; dual-run sha check
output_contracts.census: docs/cd/cd3a_path_census.json — quantiles, stratum/annual stability, multimodality evidence, cluster decision
